paige_legal: Legal received a customer request for a contract-level retention exemption: they want 7 years of raw audit logs retained under BYOK. Need clear acceptance criteria + contract language. Who can draft scoping notes?
ashley_product: I can draft acceptance criteria. Quick clarifying q: is customer asking Redwood to hold their keys (CMEK) or to export encrypted blobs to their vault?
liam_security: They specified BYOK but said 'manage keys on our HSM' — ambiguous. Two options: 1) Redwood stores encrypted logs but keys are customer-managed (we don't have plaintext). 2) We export periodic encrypted snapshots to customer storage. Each has different SOC2/ISO implications.
sam_engineering: From infra side: option 1 means we must support per-tenant key material and have KMS integration + key-rotation semantics. Option 2 moves storage cost and indexing off our hot path but requires export pipeline and verified delivery. Both need retention flags at ingestion.
jordan_sre: Operationally we need an escape hatch for legal hold overrides and a snapshot/restore runbook. If logs are retained 7 years we must define snapshot cadence, integrity proofs (hash chain), and recovery time objectives.
paige_legal: Contract asks: (a) explicit data residency clause, (b) custody statement (we don't hold plaintext if BYOK), (c) termination handoff process, (d) evidence format and chain-of-custody. Also need indemnity limits.
ashley_product: Proposed minimal acceptance criteria (draft):
- retention_bucket: "extended-legal" with TTL = 7y
- keying_model: "BYOK_customer_managed" or "exported_snapshots" noted
- delivery: monthly encrypted snapshot + manifest with SHA256 checksums
- audit_evidence: signed manifest and delivery receipt stored 10y
- legal_hold: toggle that pauses TTL expiry
- SLA: export job succeeds within 48h of month boundary or we fall back to on-demand export request
liam_security: Add: KMS attestation requirement (customer supplies key attestation token), HSM integration notes, and proof that Redwood never has decryption keys in plaintext.
sam_engineering: Implementation notes: per-tenant metadata, indexless archival (S3 cold tier), background export worker, verify manifest, retry/backoff. Cost estimate: +0.6-1.2 FTE infra work + storage delta.
paige_legal: Legal will draft contract clauses for custody and termination. Need product+security to approve wording by EOD Wed so legal can circulate to customer.
jordan_sre: Runbook items:
- how to pause expiry (CLI/API)
- how to trigger one-off export
- verification steps for checksum and restore
- oncall playbook for export failures
opsbot: New doc created: https://tiny.redwood/contract-retention-exemption-draft 
ashley_product: Quick risk note: keeping long-term logs in-house increases SOC2 artifact surface and will require us to map controls for archived data. Might push some customers to the export model to keep us out of scope.
liam_security: For ISO we should require periodic key attestation and monthly delivery receipts. Also require that exported snapshots use envelope encryption with customer KEK.
paige_legal: Questions for product/security to answer for the customer: 1) Will Redwood accept liability for tampered exports? 2) Who bears e-discovery cost? 3) What is the SLA for successful export?
sam_engineering: Suggest default: Redwood provides standard export for retention exemptions; customer pays incremental storage/transfer and e-discovery. If customer insists on in-house retention, require a security addendum and additional audit costs.
ashley_product: Action items:
- ashley_product + liam_security: finalize acceptance criteria doc (PR to /docs/retention-exemptions) by Wed EOD (owner: ashley_product)
- paige_legal: draft contract language by Fri
- sam_engineering: estimate implementation effort + cost model by next Tues
- jordan_sre: draft runbook skeleton by next Tues
- schedule 30m sync with customer next Thurs 10:30am PT (I'll send invite)
paige_legal: ack. tagging @customer-success for handoff after we have the draft. :white_check_mark: 
liam_security: FYI — I'll stub example attestation token and share in the doc.
ashley_product: linking internal RFC: https://tiny.redwood/rfc/retention-exemptions-proposal (please comment)
paige_legal: Thanks all — let's keep replies short. If we agree to this runway, legal will proceed with contract updates.
